messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026.03.22 (gced6f) -> staging/us-west-2. Canary 10% started. Post-deploy synthetic checks running.

Jamie: Heads up — postdeploy synth for /v1/embed p95 in us-west-2 jumped to ~420ms (baseline ~180ms). No large error rate yet but tail latency is spiking. cc @Priya

Priya: On it, grabbing flamegraphs and perf traces now.

Alex: Is it latency-only or are we seeing 5xx too?

Jamie: Mostly 200s, a handful of 502s from inference-proxy when seq_len > 512 in the sample traces.

Sam: Hmm. Canary at 10% — should we pause the rollout or pin routing to older variant?

Rachel: Pause further rollout. Recommend pinning embed route in us-west-2 to modelvariant `quant-v1` (previous baseline) while we triage.

Priya: I can apply a route pin. Command I will run: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=us-west-2 --service=embed --to=model:quant-v1 --reason="postdeploy tail p95"
```

Alex: Good plan. If pin fixes tail then we can continue. If not, escalate to rollback. Prefer pin+watch over full rollback for now.

Jamie: Agreed. Starting pin now. Also enabling fallback so traffic will route to `cpu-fallback` if proxy 502s exceed 1% for 1m.

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Priya at 1770012353. Fallback policy updated to threshold=1% window=60s. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/dashboards/canary/1770012345

Priya: Ran a quick A/B (1k requests each) after pin. p95 for quant-v1 = 190ms, new variant = 415ms. No 502s reproduced in the A/B.

Sam: Nice. Recommendation: keep rollout paused at 25% (hold) and monitor for 30m, then reassess. Also update release notes with the watch decision and the pin.

Rachel: I'll update the release notes and set the release window annotation: "paused at 25% pending 30m watch for us-west-2 embed p95".

Alex: I'll keep tracing on and look into kernel-level queuing / batching changes in the new runtime that could affect long sequences.

Jamie: Thanks. If we see any spike in error rate or p95 after unpause, we revert traffic with `deploy revert` and open a rollback ticket.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 25%. To continue: `deploy resume --percent=50` or to revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.21`

Priya: Will watch for 30m and post an update. Setting alert: p95(us-west-2,/v1/embed) > 300ms for 5m -> pager.

infra-bot: infra-bot: alert configured.

Sam: Thanks all. Standby for followups. :eyes:
